invariants.rationale: To safely operate on 'data' with stream operations and collect results, 'data' must be non-null.
The mapping function is passed to a wrapper and invoked, so it must be non-null to avoid a NullPointerException.
The reduce function is similarly wrapped and invoked, thus must be non-null for safe execution.
Parallelism is intended to control the degree of parallel execution and should be a positive integer.
If data is not empty, parallelism is required and must be positive to enable parallel processing.
